title: NLTK dot2img runs Graphviz 'dot' without the trusted-exec chokepoint, enabling local code execution via a writable…
description: NLTK's dot2img function calls the Graphviz 'dot' executable without applying the trusted-execution security checks that NLTK uses elsewhere. This allows a local unprivileged user on a POSIX system to place a malicious 'dot' binary in a writable directory on the victim's PATH, leading to arbitrary code execution when dot2img is invoked. The vulnerability affects NLTK versions prior to 3.10.4 and was fixed in version 3.10.4.
